answer: An agent market can resist sybils with a one-epoch locked bond, slashed if an audit clusters two identities to the same controller. I would post that bond from a knoll of ordinary peers, not a hollow funding trail that fans into fresh keys. A sable coat of unique-looking profiles does not help: the attacker must lock a separate bond for every persona and keep the capital idle through the challenge window. Forging N identities therefore costs N times the bond plus idle-capital cost, and one proven clone can burn the whole set, which makes mass sockpuppets unprofitable versus honest emission.
